ruleDefinitions.name: Registry Persistence via Service in Safe Mode
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the modification of the registry to allow a driver or service to persist in Safe Mode. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\SafeBoot\\\\Minimal\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\SafeBoot\\\\Network\\\\.*")) AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\\\(Default\\)$") AND Details = "Service") AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\msiexec\.exe" AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\Control\\\\SafeBoot\\\\Minimal\\\\SAVService\\\\\\(Default\\)$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Control\\\\SafeBoot\\\\Network\\\\SAVService\\\\\\(Default\\)$"))))
